name: Barrette
description: A black plastic hair clip on a steel spring, dressed with a pink bow, rhinestones and two small pearls.
notes: Lying ornaments up, 75 mm long: a black bar on a steel clasp, a pink bow in the middle and clear rhinestones and pearl beads along it. The model keeps the clip's real size. Takes a new `hair` slot shared with hairpins and headbands: none of the existing slots fits, and `head` would clash with hats and helmets. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Bat charm anklet
description: A black cord anklet hung with little black bat charms and red drop charms.
notes: Lying flat, 250 mm round: a black cord with three black plastic bats and three red drops on small silver rings, all pointing outward. The loop encloses floor inside the box. It takes `ankle`, the slot ankle pouches use, so the two cannot be worn together. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wooden bead bracelet
description: A stretch bracelet of round wooden beads. It can be counted through like prayer beads.
notes: Lying flat: 22 walnut beads 8 mm across in a ring 68 mm wide; the elastic hides inside the beads. The loop encloses floor inside the box. Takes a new `wrist` slot: `hands` would clash with gloves. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wooden bead earrings
description: A pair of earrings, each a silver ear wire with three wooden beads strung below it.
notes: A pair lying flat side by side, each 32 mm long: a silver hook and three walnut beads, the middle one larger. Takes a new `earrings` slot: `ears` belongs to ear muffs and covers, which can be worn over earrings. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wooden bead necklace
description: A long string of wooden beads with a larger bead and a red tassel at the bottom. It can be counted through like prayer beads.
notes: Lying flat: 60 birch beads 10 mm across in a ring 210 mm wide, with a larger guru bead and a red cord tassel at +z. The loop encloses floor inside the box. Takes a new `neck` slot shared with necklaces, lockets, medals and collars: none of the existing slots fits. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Friendship bracelet
description: A woven cord bracelet in red, yellow and blue, threaded with wooden letter cubes and a couple of plastic beads, its ends left long for tying.
notes: Lying flat: a woven band 66 mm across banded red, yellow and blue, two tie ends trailing at -z past a knot, three birch letter cubes at +z and a green and an orange bead at the sides. The loop encloses floor inside the box. Takes the new `wrist` slot, as the wooden bead bracelet does. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Bronze medal
description: A third-place medal on a red neck ribbon. It looks like bronze but is struck in brass.
notes: A struck disc 60 mm across with a raised rim and a lighter raised star, hanging from a small ring and a brass bar on a red ribbon with a cream stripe, laid flat and folded short so its two legs meet in a V. Medal in `bronze` for its colour, the star in `brass-polished`. The model is a flat ribbon and disc a few millimetres thick, and its box counts the floor inside the ribbon loop. Takes the new `neck` slot. Gold and silver medals share the model with their own finishes. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Black bunny ears
description: A headband with a pair of tall black fuzzy rabbit ears, pink inside. Costume wear.
notes: Standing on the band's ends, front on +z: a black velvet band 150 mm across and two ears 150 mm tall, splayed a little, with pink inner faces. The open arch encloses air inside the box. Takes the new `hair` slot rather than `head`, so a hat cannot go over it either way. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Collar with bow tie
description: A detached white shirt collar with a black bow tie fixed at the throat. Part of a showgirl costume.
notes: Standing on its lower edge, front on +z: a white band 130 mm across and 40 mm tall, wing tips folded down at the front, a gold stud at the back and a black satin bow tie 95 mm wide at the throat. The ring encloses air inside the box. Takes the new `neck` slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Collar bar
description: A slim silver bar with a ball at each end that pins a shirt collar's points together under the tie knot.
notes: Lying flat: a silver rod 55 mm long with a ball at each end. Takes a new `collar` slot: it pins through a shirt collar, which no existing slot holds; `badge` is for pinned-on badges and both can be worn at once. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Copper hoop earrings
description: A pair of heavy copper hoop earrings with hinged posts.
notes: A pair lying flat side by side: hoops 30 mm across of 4 mm wire, each with a hinge block at the top. The hoops enclose air inside the box. Takes the new `earrings` slot. Gold, silver and platinum pairs share the model with their own finishes. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Copper hairpin
description: A copper hairpin, one prong crimped in waves to grip the hair.
notes: Lying flat, 45 mm long: two copper prongs joined by a rounded bend, one crimped in waves. At the 2 mm grain the wire reads a little thick. Takes the new `hair` slot. Gold, silver and platinum hairpins share the model with their own finishes. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Copper locket
description: A round copper locket on a fine chain. It opens on a hinge to hold a small photo or a lock of hair, and has gone dull with green spots of tarnish.
notes: Lying lid up at +z on a fine copper chain laid in a ring 160 mm across: a rounded case 30 mm across and 7 mm thick with a raised ring on the lid, a hinge at the side, a bail at the top and three green tarnish spots in `paint-green` (no verdigris finish exists). The chain loop encloses floor inside the box. Takes the new `neck` slot. Gold, silver and platinum lockets share the model with their own finishes and no tarnish; the photo inside is not modelled and the locket holds nothing. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Copper necklace
description: A plain copper chain necklace with a spring-ring clasp.
notes: Laid in a ring 180 mm across: 80 links alternately flat and on edge so it reads as a chain, a spring-ring clasp and its tab at +z. The loop encloses floor inside the box. Takes the new `neck` slot. Gold, silver and platinum necklaces share the model with their own finishes. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Cowrie shell bracelet
description: A bracelet of small cowrie shells threaded on a cotton cord. It can be counted through like prayer beads.
notes: Lying flat: nine cowrie shells 18 mm long threaded slit up round a cotton cord in a ring 80 mm across, the cord tied off at -z. Shells in `bone`, slits in `chitin-brown`. The loop encloses floor inside the box. Takes the new `wrist` slot. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
